title: 海の生きものの図鑑風イラスト
lead: クジラ・シャチ・サメ・ウミガメなど、海の生きものを図鑑風のタッチで描いた素材12点です。理科の資料や水族館の案内に使えます。
subject_en: Realistic natural-history illustration style, each ONE sea animal full body, side view, centred, accurate proportions and natural colours, soft shading. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
